execution.seed_scope: NumPy PCG64 float32 flow noise, reset to same stream per episode for paired masks; differs from official default JAX RNG

notes: Official pi05 LIBERO flow-matching checkpoint. Official create_trained_policy loads checkpoint normalization assets; no extra output normalization or gripper inversion is applied here.
Set runtime.python_executable to the pinned official openpi Ubuntu/Python>=3.11 environment and repo_path to its checkout. Keep dependencies separate from the simulation environment.
Native prediction horizon is 10; the shared runner executes at most five actions per observation.

The official LIBERO dataset combines spatial/object/goal/10 and excludes LIBERO90. On 90, require both suite fields plus adapter_options.evaluation_track='zero_shot_extension' and a separate 00 regression, not an official 90-trained baseline. No claim is made that pretraining lacked similar tasks. A 90-finetuned model needs separately documented weights and matching training configuration.
Weights have not been downloaded or executed in this project; this runtime recipe is not model validation evidence.
